reviewSamples.text:
Un hombre muy amable, professional y honesto.
I left my car at his shop in the night, then I couldn't get an estimate , and he charged me little money, without taking advantage for that circumstance. And the job was perfect.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Sam F
reviewSamples.text: Had an emergency with a blown radiator just before a meeting.  A quick Google search led me to these guys who were close by and had some good reviews. I dropped the car and first thing the next morning I had a quote and a two hour turnaround time. They were fast, friendly and had honest prices. Not much more you can ask for.
